The '''Accelerator Crate''' is a special time-limited crate. It also contains only crate-exclusive units; that is, none of these units will appear in regular supply drops.

Cost: 60 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Ares]] x1 (unique to this crate)
* [[Phoenix]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Detonator]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Saber]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Slab]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Fireball]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Launcher]] x8 (unique to this crate)
* [[Blastback]] x8 (unique to this crate)
* [[Suppression Tank]] x8 (unique to this crate)
* [[Ward]] x8 (unique to this crate)
